events.title: 🧸 Demo Patch #1 ~ Fixes & Improvements
events.summary: Hello everyone! 🧸❤️A small patch is already here, just one day after the demo launch!I mentioned to quite a few people that we'd aim to release a patch on Wednesday or Thursday, but personally, I wanted to make sure everyone could have the best experience possible as soon as possible.Quite a few people reported that the motion blur made the game unplayable for them, and others experienced some optimization issues. So, we worked hard to address these issues and get a patch out as soon as possible

events.title: Pack a Plush! is coming to Steam Next Fest! 🧸
